title: Thanksgiving Day and Beyond: 5 Non-Alcoholic Beers to Pour
excerpt: A crisp blonde, a Maine IPA, a grapefruit radler, a zesty session and one mystery can. Five NA beers for Thanksgiving Day and the long weekend, plus a gift idea for December.
intro:
Thanksgiving is Thursday, and it's a long day at the table: snacks while the turkey roasts, the big meal, football, pie, and leftovers that somehow taste better on Friday. Every stretch of it deserves a good beer.

Whatever your reason for pouring NA this year, here are five picks to carry you from the first appetizer to the last game of the weekend. Each one is a single can, so mix them into a Build Your Own 12-Pack and set out something for everyone.

blurbs.39610: Bulltown Blonde is the flagship from Bulltown Brewing, a crew of Midwestern dads who believe beer should taste like beer. It's crisp and fuller-bodied than you'd expect from a blonde, the kind of easy, familiar pour that works for the relatives who just want a beer. Set a few out with the main course.
blurbs.36205: Wave Finder comes from 1820 Brewing in Portland, Maine, built on Mosaic, Cascade, El Dorado and Citra hops over malted barley and wheat. Expect bright citrus, real hop bitterness and a crisp, clean finish. An IPA's bite stands up to rich sides like stuffing and gravy, and it's a natural for the afternoon football game.
blurbs.40782: Bulltown's Grapefruit Radler pairs gentle sweetness with a zesty grapefruit tang and a smooth finish. It's a lighter, brighter pour that's great with the appetizer spread, or as a refresher after the big plate. We're down to the last few cans, so grab yours soon.
blurbs.40953: Go Brewing keeps Batch 001 a secret: the style isn't disclosed, tasters sign an NDA, and only a few hundred cans were made for a small number of retailers. That makes it the perfect conversation starter at the table. Pour a can, pass it around and let everyone guess what it is.
blurbs.40885: Athletic Brewing made Aftershift Zesty Session with chefs including Chris Cosentino, and it shows: a golden, light-bodied beer with vibrant lime leaf and yuzu, a touch of tartness and a clean finish. It's made for the cook, the one to open once the dishes are done. Only a handful of cans are left.

outro:
